subject: Hosting qualification and regulatory checkpoints — Lumen Health (post-call triage)
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Clarke <evan.clarke@lumenhealth.com>; Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-04T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Hosting qualification and regulatory checkpoints — Lumen Health (post-call triage)
Attachments: SOC2-snapshot-2027.pdf (application/pdf), network-checklist-template.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Evan — thanks for the time today. Quick recap and concrete next steps so we keep momentum while your security and procurement teams align.

TL;DR
- Key drivers: HIPAA + contractual residency (US-only), strict egress controls, and potential air-gapped/private deployment due to regulatory segmentation.
- Immediate asks from Lumen: sample SOC 2 evidence, network topology/peering options, and a rough procurement timeline & ballpark for a dedicated private deployment.

Recap of pain points and goals from today's call
- Data residency: all PHI must remain in US regions with no multi-region backups.
- Egress & flow control: Lumen requires deny-by-default egress from hosting environment and explicit allowlist for outbound monitoring.
- Air-gap possibility: if legal deems it necessary, a fully isolated deployment (no public internet egress) may be required for one environment (production).
- Key management: customer-managed KMS/HSM integration and hardware-backed key rotation preferred.
- Auditability: 1-year immutable audit log retention + paper trail for access approvals.
- Timeline: target a pilot environment in Q3; procurement indicated a 6–10 week cycle pending SOW/contract.

What we (Redwood) can immediately provide
- SOC 2 snapshot and evidence package (attached).
- Network checklist template for your infra/security teams to fill in (attached).
- Options: Hosted private (dedicated GPU pool, VPC peering + egress controls) OR on-prem appliance package (air-gap variant) — both support customer KMS and isolated audit logs.

Proposed next steps (owners + due dates)
1) Aditya (me) — send full SOC 2 evidence packet and a one-page hosting options matrix by EOD Monday (2027-06-07).
2) Monica (CS/solutions) — circulate the network checklist to your infra team and request completed topology by 2027-06-11.
3) Ben (sales) — provide a ballpark TCO for a dedicated private deployment (monthly) and a pilot pricing option by 2027-06-09.
4) Evan / Lumen — please confirm procurement contact(s) and preferred time windows for an infra + security deep-dive next week.

Meeting to propose: 60-minute infra deep-dive (security + networking + procurement) — suggested slots Wed 6/9 or Thu 6/10. We will invite our infra engineer and security lead.

Notes on constraints we flagged during the call
- If Lumen requires full air-gap (no outbound monitoring), there will be additional onboarding time for on-prem hardware certification and separate build pipelines (~4–6 weeks extra).
- Customer-managed KMS may require an HSM proxy during bootstrap; we'll need IP allowlist for HSM endpoints.

Attachments referenced
- SOC2-snapshot-2027.pdf — short package with control mappings and auditor letter.
- network-checklist-template.xlsx — fill-in fields for subnets, NAT/eBPF patterns, egress policies, IDS/IPS placement, and required ports.

If this aligns, Evan — can you reply with the procurement POC and best time for the deep-dive?

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Aditya — thanks for the concise recap. A few clarifications from our side: 
- Procurement POC is procurement@lumenhealth.com (I'll loop them on the deep-dive).
- Security wants explicit confirmation that audit logs can be stored in an immutable store in a customer-controlled S3 (or equivalent) and that retention policies are configurable.
- On KMS: we will require integration with our managed HSM and the option to rotate keys independently of Redwood. Please include any caveats.
- For ballpark pricing: we need a staged proposal (pilot, then dedicated production with SLA). If you can provide a rough monthly cost range for 3-node dedicated capacity and an on-prem pilot delta, that would help procurement triage.

Regarding the air-gap: legal will confirm if they require fully isolated production — if so, expect additional compliance gating. Is 6–10 weeks realistic for procurement + legal review if SOW and security docs are in order?

We can do the infra deep-dive Wed 2027-06-09 at 10:00 AM ET. I'll bring our security architect (Nadia) and procurement lead. Loop in whoever from infra/security on your side.

Quick alignment and updated owners: 
- Aditya: SOC2 package (attached earlier) + one-page hosting options matrix — due 2027-06-07 (sent). Link: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/LumenHealth-security-q/form-response
- Monica: network checklist + FAQ — due 2027-06-07 (in progress).
- Ben: ballpark pricing for 3-node dedicated + on-prem pilot delta — deliver by 2027-06-09 before meeting.
- Procurement@lumenhealth.com: please share any mandatory contract language redlines you need included ahead of the SOW draft.

Proposed timeline (high level):
- 2027-06-09: infra deep-dive (security + procurement + infra).
- 2027-06-18: SOW + initial commercial terms draft to procurement for review.
- 2027-07-05: target start of pilot environment (provisioning dependent on network approvals).

Risks and flags to watch during the deep-dive:
- Air-gap requirement drastically increases provisioning lead time and hardware/ops costs. We'll outline the delta in the options matrix.
- Customer-managed HSM: will need IP allowlist and a brief runbook for key rotation during onboarding.
- Immutable logs in a customer-controlled bucket: we support export and retention config, but we'll need to validate your retention SLA (immutable vs. legal-hold processes).

If there are any items to add to the agenda for Wed, drop them here and we'll update the invite. Looking forward to connecting.
